assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE coherent sprite of a miniature Pekorumble Derby race-track machine for a tile roguelike, final224x160 native,112x80 logical. Input 1 subject reference only, actual game has an ivory rabbit-shaped shell with a glimpse of green racetrack under it; omit its UI, player, pink annotations. Input 2 style reference only. Main form is a wide clearly legible oval with THREE separated pale tan lanes around a dark muted green infield, a short checkerboard finish stripe, little cream rail and subdued bronze low plinth. On the BACK EDGE only, a large stylized ivory Nousagi rabbit-face open arch with two short ears, tiny coral inner ears and dark simple eyes, with a wide dark opening over the rear lane, so most of the oval is visible. Three small white rabbit racers with muted red, blue, yellow scarves spaced on the track, not human. Slight top/front camera like pixel dungeon furniture, broad square pixel clusters, low detail, 18 flat colors, 2 shades per material. True transparent background. No text, UI, portraits, glow, gradients, antialias, scattered props, floor outside the plinth or separate sprite sheet.
